verdict.rationale: LangSmith ships an official MCP server (langchain-ai/langsmith-mcp-server), and its docs state traces can be filtered and exported via the API, so an agent can query trace data through either route. Its llms.txt and markdown docs are also agent-readable. Missing for 10: documentation of which traces, metrics and eval-result tools the MCP server exposes; explicit evidence that dashboard metrics and experiment/eval results can be queried via the API; a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404); independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
